items.title: Lillian De Pass Interview, 1960-06-20
items.q: Well, that was Henry Julian's, uh, brother-in-law.

ctx.x: A little bit of a fellow. Well, that was Henry Julian's, uh, brother-in-law. I think he used to play on that saxophone, eh?
Oh, I think Didi told me about Henry Julian. I believe Didi mentioned him one time. Oh, yeah.
